  <section id="welcome-to-pypdf">
<h1>
Welcome to pypdf
<a class="headerlink" href="#welcome-to-pypdf" title="Link to this heading"></a>
</h1>
<p>
pypdf is a 
<a class="reference external" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Free_software">free</a>
 and open
source pure-python PDF library capable of splitting,
merging, cropping, and transforming the pages of PDF files. It can also add
custom data, viewing options, and passwords to PDF files.
pypdf can retrieve text and metadata from PDFs as well.
</p>
<p>
See 
<a class="reference external" href="https://github.com/py-pdf/pdfly">pdfly</a>
 for a CLI application that uses pypdf to interact with PDFs.
</p>
<p>
You can contribute to 
<a class="reference external" href="https://github.com/py-pdf/pypdf">pypdf on GitHub</a>
.
</p>
